io.name: clk
io.description: Clock signal; state transitions occur on the positive edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Synchronous active-high reset; when asserted at a positive clock edge, the FSM is forced to state A.

io.name: in
io.description: Single-bit input controlling the next-state transition.

io.name: out
io.description: Moore output; depends only on the current state (1 in state D, 0 otherwise).

functional_summary.overview: Moore finite state machine with four states (A, B, C, D), one input (in), one output (out), and a synchronous active-high reset to state A. The output is a function of the current state only: out=1 in state D, out=0 in states A, B, and C.
rules: On a positive clock edge with reset asserted, the next state is A regardless of in.
On a positive clock edge with reset deasserted, the next state is determined by the current state and in according to the transition table.
State A: if in=0 next state is A; if in=1 next state is B.
State B: if in=0 next state is C; if in=1 next state is B.
State C: if in=0 next state is A; if in=1 next state is D.
State D: if in=0 next state is C; if in=1 next state is B.
The output out is 1 when the current state is D and 0 when the current state is A, B, or C.
The output reflects the current state (Moore behavior) and is stable for the duration of the state.
